source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As long as an enemy unit is in **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of no units of yours except **FORTIFICATIONS**:

- it can still be picked as a target for ranged attacks, with −1 to the **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** for each such attack not made with a [Pistol](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)
- while **Battle-shocked**, its models skip **[Desperate Escape Tests](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** for [Falling Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), unless they would cross over enemy models
